title: Email a group of contacts
blurb: Send a quick email to a filtered list straight from Contacts.

steps.title: Pick your group
steps.body: Open a smart list or filter the list to the people you want to email.

steps.title: Select them
steps.body: Tick the contacts, or tick the top box to select everyone shown.

steps.title: Choose Send Email
steps.body: Click the email icon in the toolbar.

steps.title: Write your email
steps.body: Choose **Quick Compose** for a simple email, **Smart Builder** for a designed one, or pick an existing template.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Send yourself a test email and check it on your phone.

steps.title: Send or schedule
steps.body: Choose to send now, schedule it, or use drip mode, then review and send. Unsubscribed and Do Not Disturb contacts are skipped for you.
steps.tip: For a proper newsletter with stats, see **Send a marketing campaign** in the Guide.
